paragraphs.P01: Mayfly density was lower in streams with higher neonicotinoid concentrations (rho = −0.52, 31 streams). One possible explanation is that sublethal exposure impairs larval development, as reported for other aquatic insects (Lindqvist et al., 2020), but we did not measure larval development, and agricultural runoff carries other stressors that could produce the same pattern.
paragraphs.P02: In a paired ex vivo stimulation of whole blood from 31 participants, TNF-α secretion at 6 h after stimulation with lipopolysaccharide (100 ng/mL) was lower than in the paired pre-exposure sample (geometric mean ratio 0.64, 95% CI 0.48–0.85). A dampened inflammatory response could point to a mechanism by which these participants were protected from severe disease, but severe disease was not recorded.
paragraphs.P03: In a paired ex vivo stimulation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 24 participants, IFN-γ secretion at 24 h after stimulation with schizont lysate (10 µg/mL) was higher than in unstimulated paired cultures (geometric mean ratio 2.1, 95% CI 1.5–2.9). These findings suggest a possible mechanism of protection in the participants, although clinical outcomes were not assessed in this study.
paragraphs.P04: In 150 adults with type 2 diabetes, higher fasting plasma lactate was associated with higher HbA1c (rho = 0.31, 95% CI 0.15–0.45). The association was similar after adjustment for age and BMI (adjusted rho = 0.28, 95% CI 0.11–0.43). Because the data are cross-sectional, they cannot show whether lactate affects glycaemic control, whether glycaemic control affects lactate, or whether a third factor affects both.
paragraphs.P05: Of 1180 households surveyed in the dry season of 2024, 311 (26%, 95% CI 24–29%) reported at least one episode of diarrhoea in a child under five during the preceding two weeks. Prevalence was 31% in the lowest wealth quintile and 19% in the highest. The survey did not record water source, so it cannot show why prevalence differed.
paragraphs.P06: In 60 undergraduates at a single university, randomly assigned to spaced or massed practice, spaced practice raised final-exam scores by 7 points (95% CI 2–12). These results are consistent with laboratory studies of the spacing effect (Cepeda et al., 2006), although our sample was small and drawn from one introductory course, so the size of the benefit in other settings is uncertain.
paragraphs.P07: In the randomised trial (n = 480), intensive glycaemic control lowered HbA1c at 12 months compared with standard care (mean difference −0.6 percentage points, 95% CI −0.8 to −0.4). In an exploratory subgroup analysis, the difference appeared larger in participants younger than 60 years (−0.8 vs −0.4 percentage points), but the test for interaction was not significant (p = 0.21).
paragraphs.P08: Validation accuracy at epoch 5 was strongly associated with final out-of-distribution accuracy across our 40 training runs (R² = 0.61, computed on the same runs), suggesting that early validation performance may be a useful signal for model selection. Whether it would predict out-of-distribution accuracy for new architectures or datasets remains to be tested.
paragraphs.P09: Knockdown of GENE1 reduced colony formation by 38% (95% CI 22–51%; n = 6 biological replicates), whereas knockdown of GENE2 produced a smaller reduction of 9% that was not statistically significant (95% CI −4 to 21%; p = 0.17). Neither knockdown detectably changed cell viability at 72 h.
paragraphs.P10: In this cohort of 212 adults, higher baseline CD161+ CD4 T-cell frequency was associated with a longer time to parasitaemia (HR 0.72, 95% CI 0.55–0.95; p = 0.018), and the association persisted after adjustment for age and prior malaria episodes (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.57–0.99). Participants in the top tertile remained parasite-free for a median of 41 days, compared with 27 days in the bottom tertile. These cells may therefore contribute to early parasite control, although the observational design does not allow us to determine whether they are protective.
paragraphs.P11: In a paired ex vivo stimulation of CD4 T cells from 18 participants, IL-10 secretion at 48 h after stimulation with anti-CD3/CD28 beads was higher than in unstimulated paired cultures (geometric mean ratio 1.8, 95% CI 1.2–2.7). This response might reflect a regulatory mechanism that protected participants from symptomatic infection, although we did not test its association with infection outcomes.
paragraphs.P12: In a randomised, double-blind trial of 90 adults with chronic low back pain, 8 weeks of drug A lowered mean pain intensity by 1.4 points on a 0–10 scale compared with placebo (95% CI 0.6 to 2.2; p = 0.001). Adverse events were similar between arms (22% vs 20%). Participants came from one outpatient clinic, so the effect in other populations is unknown.
